HTTP requests that fail while reading or writing the body after successful headers can report ERROR spans without `error.type`. Classify these terminal failures in the shared HTTP extractor so both spans and request-duration metrics include the error.

- **Classification:** Preserve the response status and HTTP-error-code precedence; otherwise use custom classification before falling back to the terminal exception type. Leave successful operations and existing cancellation handling unchanged.
- **Coverage:** Add shared client/server span and duration-metric regressions, plus a real Jetty HTTP 200 response truncated during body consumption.
metadata.title: Fix HTTP error.type for terminal failures after successful headers
